items.title: /e/OS is a complete, fully “deGoogled” mobile ecosystem
items.title_zh: /e/OS：一套完整、彻底“去谷歌化”的移动生态
items.summary: /e/OS is an open-source mobile operating system paired with selected applications that the foundation describes as a complete, fully deGoogled mobile ecosystem. It argues that open source makes its privacy claims auditable.

items.title: Open Camera is a FOSS camera app for Android
items.title_zh: Open Camera：Android 上的开源相机应用
items.summary: Open Camera is an open-source camera app for Android phones and tablets. Some features may not be available on all devices because they depend on hardware, camera capabilities or the Android version.

items.title: Claude is an Electron App because we've lost native
items.title_zh: Claude 是 Electron 应用，因为原生开发已无优势
items.summary: The essay argues that Claude's Electron-based desktop app reflects how little advantage native development still offers, rather than any inability of LLMs.

items.title: Most-read tech publications have lost over half their Google traffic since 2024
items.title_zh: 多家头部科技媒体自 2024 年以来 Google 流量减少一半以上
items.summary: An analysis that tracked CNET, Wired, The Verge, TechRadar and six other publications from 2024 to the present says they collectively lost 65 million monthly Google visits.

items.title: Bet on German Train Delays
items.title_zh: 押注德国火车晚点
items.summary: Bahn.bet is a prediction-market site where users can bet on Deutsche Bahn departure delays.

items.title: RFC 9849. TLS Encrypted Client Hello

items.title_zh: AI 对劳动力市场的影响：一项新指标与早期证据
items.summary: Anthropic introduces a measure called “observed exposure” that combines LLM capability with real Claude usage data, and shares early evidence on employment effects.

items.summary: Lumafield's scan-of-the-month feature uses industrial CT scans to show the engineering inside health wearables including the Oura Ring, Dexcom G7, and Jabra hearing aids.

items.title_zh: 科技行业就业状况现已明显差于 2008 和 2020 年衰退期
items.summary: A social media post argues that tech employment is now significantly worse than it was during the 2008 or 2020 recessions.

items.title_zh: 小米开启类 OpenClaw 手机 AI 智能体 Xiaomi miclaw 小范围封闭测试

items.title_zh: council-of-high-intelligence：面向难题的多视角结构化审议
items.summary: A Shell-based tool for structured multi-perspective deliberation on hard decisions, running full councils, focused triads or duo debates across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.

items.title: AnInsomniacy/rayburst
items.title_zh: AnInsomniacy/rayburst
items.summary: rayburst is an open-source download manager written in TypeScript, described by its authors as redefining the category.

items.title_zh: BigBodyCobain/Shadowbroker：开源情报平台
items.summary: Shadowbroker aggregates open-source intelligence such as private jet movements, spy satellites and seismic events in one interface, and can connect an AI agent to search the data for correlations.

items.title_zh: xstongxue/best-skills：高质量 Skills 合集
items.summary: A general-purpose collection of high-quality skills, written in Python.

items.title: Emanuele-web04/remodex
items.title_zh: remodex：Codex 远程控制工具
items.summary: remodex is a Swift project that provides remote control for Codex.

items.title_zh: FreedomIntelligence/OpenClaw-Medical-Skills——面向 OpenClaw 的最大开源医疗 AI 技能库

items.title: tanweai/pua
items.title_zh: tanweai/pua——给 AI 代理的“绩效改进计划”技能
items.summary: pua is a Python skill for agents, described as high-agency, that casts the AI as a P8-level engineer placed on a 30-day performance improvement plan.

items.title: skalesapp/skales
items.title_zh: skalesapp/skales——跨平台个人 AI 代理
items.summary: Skales is a personal AI agent for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS that handles coding, desktop and browser automation and scheduled tasks, supporting 26 AI providers, local Ollama models, MCP and Agent2Agent without Docker or a terminal.

items.title: TML-Bench: Benchmark for Data Science Agents on Tabular ML Tasks
items.title_zh: TML-Bench：面向表格机器学习任务的数据科学 Agent 基准
items.summary: TML-Bench evaluates data science agents on Kaggle-style tabular tasks, testing 10 open-source LLMs across four competitions and three time budgets; MiniMax-M2.1 had the best aggregate score under the paper’s primary aggregation.

items.title: Compression Method Matters: Benchmark-Dependent Output Dynamics in LLM Prompt Compression
items.title_zh: 压缩方法很重要：LLM 提示压缩中随基准而变的输出动态
items.summary: A controlled replication across 5,400 API calls finds that aggressive prompt compression can sharply increase output length in benchmark-dependent ways: at r=0.3, DeepSeek expanded outputs 56x on MBPP but 5x on HumanEval, while GPT-4o-mini stayed comparatively stable. The authors identify prompt structure, rather than provider identity alone, as the primary moderator and introduce an instruction-survival metric and a Compression Robustness Index.

items.title: The Compression Paradox in LLM Inference: Provider-Dependent Energy Effects of Prompt Compression
items.title_zh: LLM 推理中的压缩悖论：提示压缩能耗效应的提供商差异
items.summary: Across 28,421 successful API trials with three providers and five benchmarks, prompt compression caused substantial quality loss and strongly provider-dependent energy effects; DeepSeek's output length rose from 21 to 798 tokens at r=0.3, with estimated energy increases up to 2,140%, while GPT-4o-mini showed mixed results including a reduction at r=0.5.

items.title: Can Computational Reducibility Lead to Transferable Models for Graph Combinatorial Optimization?
items.title_zh: 计算可归约性能否带来可迁移的图组合优化模型？
items.summary: The authors introduce a GNN encoder that uses a GCON module for expressive message passing together with energy-based unsupervised losses, then draw on computational reducibility to design pretraining and fine-tuning strategies that transfer across tasks such as MVC, MIS and MaxClique. They report that pretraining on all but one task almost always speeds convergence on the remaining task without negative transfer.

items.title: Neuro-Symbolic Financial Reasoning via Deterministic Fact Ledgers and Adversarial Low-Latency Hallucination Detector
items.title_zh: 用确定性事实账本与对抗式低延迟幻觉检测器实现神经符号金融推理
items.summary: The paper introduces VeNRA, a neuro-symbolic agent that retrieves deterministic variables through a typed Universal Fact Ledger bounded by a Double-Lock Grounding algorithm and reports systemic hallucination rates down to 1.2%. It also presents VeNRA Sentinel, a 3-billion-parameter model trained through adversarial simulation that outperforms 70B+ frontier models at error detection.

items.title: A Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction System
items.title_zh: 动态自演化信息抽取系统
items.summary: DySECT is a dynamic self-evolving extraction and curation toolkit that incrementally builds a knowledge base of LLM-extracted triples, enriches it with probabilistic knowledge and graph-based reasoning, and feeds it back into the extractor through prompt tuning, few-shot sampling, or synthetic-data fine-tuning.

items.title: Position: LLMs Must Use Functor-Based and RAG-Driven Bias Mitigation for Fairness
items.title_zh: 立场论文：LLM 应结合函子方法与 RAG 缓解偏见
items.summary: A position paper advocates addressing demographic and gender bias in LLMs by combining category-theoretic, functor-based transformations that map biased semantic domains to unbiased canonical forms with retrieval-augmented generation that injects external knowledge at inference.

items.title: Training-free Temporal Object Tracking in Surgical Videos
items.title_zh: 手术视频中的免训练时序目标跟踪
items.summary: The authors present a training-free method for tracking anatomical structures and instruments in laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos using features from pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models, reporting 79.19% per-pixel accuracy on CholeSeg8K.
